title: Lazy Sunday Tagine
description: A hearty, slow-cooked Italian-inspired stew perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon.

ingredients.name: middle eastern rest meat (such as lamb or beef)

instructions: Heat the garlicky olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the middle eastern rest meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Stir in the dried prunes and honey.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
